data.body:
Checked against origin/main de94cc70b3b: the glue still exists and is still load-bearing. tests/conftest.py:358 calls `_linux_host_script_skip_reason(relative_posix, sys.platform)` inside `pytest_collection_modifyitems` and adds the skip marker. Gerrit 3402's per-class deselect argfiles (.github/windows-sweep-deselect/*.args) do not list any of the host-script test modules the hook skips (grep for the 7 path fragments in those files: 0 hits), so the hook is not superseded.

Implemented in tests/unit/test_conftest_windows_skip_rule.py: two cases drive the hook with a fake item under tests/scripts/test_vartmp_cap.py, with `_live_jira_confinement` and `_subprocess_isolation` stubbed. win32 yields one skip marker naming 1ebf-599a-e15c-465d; linux yields none. 27 passed locally. With the glue call replaced by `skip_reason = None`, the win32 case fails (1 failed, 26 passed) and the conftest was then restored from HEAD. Only pathlib and monkeypatch are used, so the cases are portable to the Windows sweep. make verify running.
